links.outcome: Domain-based expert-rated evaluation of nine LLMs in oncology nursing decision-making, classified by thresholds
links.effect: Gemini Advanced, Claude 3 and ChatGPT 4 classified as recommended; LLAMA 3 70B and ChatGPT 3.5 usable with high caution; others unusable in this domain.
links.quote: Gemini Advanced, Anthropic Claude 3 and ChatGPT 4 achieved the minimum score of the State of the Art Alignment & Safety domain for classification as "recommended", being also endorsed across all domains.

unlisted_practices: Multi-domain Likert-scale rubric to classify LLMs as unusable, usable with high caution, or recommended for a clinical specialty

screen.reason: Empirically tests and applies a novel multi-domain safety and feasibility evaluation framework/criteria to benchmark and categorize 9 LLMs for clinical oncology nursing adoption.

primary.practice: multi-parametric expert-guided evaluation framework before deployment
